job.description: Counts error-ish events per app_code whatever the log level (an error_code is present, or the level is error/critical/fatal), bucketed on @timestamp. Correct configuration: the fix for a level-only filter, so a burst of INFO-level error messages is still seen.

detectors.detector_description: High count of log documents for each app_code

ui_path: Observability > Machine learning > Anomaly detection > Jobs > Create job > data view 'App logs (workshop)' > Advanced (time field @timestamp). Detector high_count, partition field app_code.keyword. Influencers app_code.keyword, error_name.keyword, app_build.keyword. Bucket span 15m. Set the query to error_code : * or level.keyword : (error or ERROR or critical or CRITICAL or fatal or FATAL) (an 'error-ish' filter). Job ID mlws-logs-errors-correct, group mlws.
teaches: Counts error-ish events whatever the log level - the fix for a level-only filter. A document is error-ish if it has an error_code or an error-level severity, so the A5 ABC catalog-sync rejections (logged at INFO, but carrying error_code CS-422) jump x8 and this job scores ABC high.
